core.name: Core Pack
core.desc: File Search and required KeepItLocal pages. Always installed.

utils.name: Utilities Pack
utils.desc: Hashing, encoders, QR, calculators, passwords, and format helpers.

development.name: Development Pack
development.desc: JWT, SQL, regex, diff, JSON, fake data, IDs, and Markdown helpers.

privacy.name: Privacy Pack
privacy.desc: Metadata inspection/sanitizing, redaction, and shredding tools.

archive.name: Archive Pack
archive.desc: Create, extract, and repair archives locally.

document.name: Documents Pack
document.desc: Word, CSV, spreadsheet, and document conversion/cleanup tools.

image.name: Image Pack
image.desc: Image conversion, compression, resizing, favicons, Base64, and watermarking.

file.name: File Tools Pack
file.desc: Cleaner/analyzer, duplicate finder, and bulk rename workflows.

about.name: About
about.desc: Overview and guided starting points for KeepItLocal.

clipboard-history.name: Clipboard History
clipboard-history.desc: Searchable history of everything you copy.

snippets.name: Snippets
snippets.desc: Reusable templates expanded into any app via clipboard overlay.

voice-to-text.name: Voice to Text
voice-to-text.desc: Speak — KeepItLocal transcribes locally. Auto-arms with overlays; mic toggle on pages.

file-search-index.name: File Search Index
file-search-index.desc: Manage indexed sources, rebuilds, exclusions, and live watcher behavior.

profiles.name: Profiles
profiles.desc: Manage visible tool collections for different workflows.

documentation.name: Documentation
documentation.desc: In-app guidance for KeepItLocal tools and offline workflows.

hash-check.name: Hash Check
hash-check.docsUse: Verify file integrity or compare file fingerprints.
hash-check.docsOffline: Hashing should never require uploading the file you want to verify.
hash-check.docsTip: Use SHA-256 for modern verification. MD5 is mostly for legacy compatibility.

encoders.name: Encoders
encoders.desc: Base64, Hex, URL, HTML, Binary, ROT13
encoders.docsUse: Encode/decode Base64, URL, Hex, HTML, Binary, and ROT13 text.
encoders.docsOffline: Encoded data can still contain secrets, tokens, URLs, or private payloads.
encoders.docsTip: Do not paste real tokens or secrets into random online decoders.

qr-code.name: QR Code
qr-code.docsUse: Generate QR codes for text, URLs, Wi-Fi info, or small payloads.
qr-code.docsOffline: QR content can contain private links, internal URLs, or Wi-Fi credentials.
qr-code.docsTip: Double-check the encoded content before sharing the QR image.

format-converter.name: Format Converter
format-converter.desc: Convert & explore JSON, YAML, TOML, XML
format-converter.docsUse: Convert or inspect structured text such as JSON/YAML/TOML/XML.
format-converter.docsOffline: Configuration files can contain API keys, internal URLs, credentials, or customer data.
format-converter.docsTip: Remove secrets before sharing formatted output.

secret-leak-scanner.name: Secret Leak Scanner
secret-leak-scanner.desc: Scan pasted snippets for credentials, tokens, and PII leaks
secret-leak-scanner.docsUse: Scan tokens, config snippets, and logs before sharing or committing.
secret-leak-scanner.docsOffline: All scanning runs in-browser and never uploads pasted content.
secret-leak-scanner.docsTip: Use strict mode for security reviews and PII mode for privacy-first checks.

password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.docsOffline: Passwords and recovery strings should not be generated by a random website you do not control.
password-generator.docsTip: Prefer long unique passwords stored in a password manager.

util-calculator.name: Calculator
util-calculator.desc: A calculating notepad — math, units, percentages and variables, all on-device.

file-search.name: File Search
file-search.desc: Indexed local file search with live updates
file-search.docsUse: Build a local search index and find files using advanced search (AND, OR, quotes, ext:, path:, size:).
file-search.docsOffline: Indexing and search stay on your machine. No file content is uploaded.
file-search.docsTip: Start with metadata-only indexing for huge folders, then enable content indexing when needed.

cleaner-analyzer.name: Cleaner / Analyzer
cleaner-analyzer.desc: Analyze safe cache bloat, old large files, startup items, RAM, and disk usage
cleaner-analyzer.docsUse: Find safe cache cleanup targets and review large old files or startup entries.
cleaner-analyzer.docsOffline: Cleaner analysis stays local and does not delete personal files or applications.
cleaner-analyzer.docsTip: Only cache/temp targets can be cleaned, and cleanup requires typing CONFIRM.

duplicate-finder.name: Duplicate Finder
duplicate-finder.desc: Find exact duplicate files recursively and move duplicates to review

bulk-rename.name: Bulk Rename
bulk-rename.desc: Preview and safely rename many files or folders

automation-recipes.name: Automations
automation-recipes.desc: Build simple local recipes from KeepItLocal tools

file-shredder.name: File Shredder
file-shredder.docsUse: Delete selected files more aggressively than normal deletion.
file-shredder.docsOffline: Destructive file operations should stay under your control and should never be delegated to a website.
file-shredder.docsTip: Use carefully and keep backups of important files. SSD behavior can differ from old hard drives.

screenshot-redact.name: Screenshot Redact
screenshot-redact.desc: Blur or black out sensitive areas
screenshot-redact.docsOffline: Screenshots often contain names, tokens, emails, addresses, customer data, tabs, or account details.
screenshot-redact.docsTip: Prefer solid redaction for secrets. Blur can sometimes leak shape/context.

word-converter.name: Word Converter
word-converter.desc: Convert .docx to clean Markdown or plain text
word-converter.docsUse: Convert Word .docx files to GitHub-Flavored Markdown (headings, bold/italic, links, lists, tables, images) or plain text. All processing is local.
word-converter.docsOffline: Documents often contain personal, legal, business, or client information. Conversion never uploads anything.
word-converter.docsTip: Great for getting Word content into notes, git repos, or static sites. For PDF, use Word's built-in "Save as PDF".

csv-toolkit.name: CSV Toolkit
csv-toolkit.desc: Convert Excel ⇄ CSV, merge, clean, split, and export CSV to JSON
csv-toolkit.docsUse: Every CSV / spreadsheet job in one tool: convert spreadsheets to and from Excel (XLSX/XLS/XLSB/ODS), merge many CSV/TSV files into one, clean messy exports, split big files into chunks, and export CSV to JSON / JSONL.
csv-toolkit.docsOffline: Spreadsheets and CSV exports frequently hold customer lists, prices, finances, CRM data, and other private operational data; every mode processes files on-device with no upload.
csv-toolkit.docsTip: Pick a mode from the left rail: Convert round-trips Excel ⇄ CSV, Merge appends files, Clean normalizes messy exports, Split chunks big files, and → JSON converts to JSONL / JSON.

doc-password.name: Remove Password
doc-password.desc: Remove the "restrict editing" lock from Word .docx files
doc-password.docsUse: Strip the "restrict editing" XML flag from a Word .docx file (no password needed — that protection is non-cryptographic).
doc-password.docsOffline: All processing is local; the original file is preserved and an unlocked copy is written alongside it.
doc-password.docsTip: Word's "encrypt with open password" (full AES encryption) isn't supported — open the doc in Word and save without password to remove that variant. (PDF unlocking now lives in KeepItLocal Privacy.)

jwt-decoder.name: JWT Decoder
jwt-decoder.docsUse: Decode JWT header and payload locally.
jwt-decoder.docsOffline: JWTs may contain identifiers, emails, permissions, tenant IDs, or session-related information.
jwt-decoder.docsTip: Decoding is not verification. Do not trust a token just because it decodes.

regex-tool.name: Regex Tool
regex-tool.docsOffline: Test samples can contain real logs, emails, IDs, or production strings.
regex-tool.docsTip: Use realistic but sanitized samples when possible.

sql-formatter.name: SQL Formatter
sql-formatter.docsOffline: SQL can reveal schema names, table structures, business logic, and sometimes sensitive literals.
sql-formatter.docsTip: Avoid putting production secrets into SQL snippets even locally.

diff-viewer.name: Diff Viewer
diff-viewer.docsOffline: Diff content may contain source code, contracts, logs, or configuration secrets.
diff-viewer.docsTip: Useful before sending patches, comparing configs, or reviewing generated text.

markdown-preview.name: Markdown Preview
markdown-preview.desc: Render Markdown, convert HTML to Markdown

image-studio.name: Image Studio
image-studio.desc: Resize, convert, and compress images in one pass
image-studio.docsUse: Resize one image visually or many in batch, convert between formats (incl. WebP), and compress — in a single pass.
image-studio.docsOffline: Photos and screenshots often hold private scenes, people, locations, or work assets. Every operation runs on-device — nothing is uploaded.
image-studio.docsTip: Choose "Keep original" to just resize/compress, or pick WebP for the smallest web-ready files. Single mode resizes one image visually.

img-base64.name: Image to Base64
img-base64.desc: Convert images to Base64 data URIs

img-favicon.name: Favicon Generator
img-favicon.desc: Create favicon packs from one image
img-favicon.docsUse: Generate favicon and app icon files from one source image.
img-favicon.docsOffline: Brand assets and unpublished logos can stay on your machine.
img-favicon.docsTip: Start with a square, high-resolution PNG for cleaner output.

img-watermark.name: Watermark
img-watermark.desc: Add text or logo watermarks to images
img-watermark.docsUse: Add text or logo watermarks to one or many images.
img-watermark.docsOffline: Watermarking often involves original assets that should remain local until you choose to publish them.
img-watermark.docsTip: Use per-file settings when some images need different positions or opacity.
